title: The register's last line
logline: Box 40's lid, close: the register begun on it in pencil — 40 · NOV 2026– — and the line left open after the dash. The pencil on the lid. The pages that fill the box haven't happened.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard lid with BOX 40 in marker and beneath it, in pencil, a single register line — a month and year, a dash, and nothing after it — the pencil lying on the lid, the lamp's light across the cardboard.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a cardboard box lid marked in black marker with a single pencilled line beneath ending in a dash and nothing after it, a pencil lying on the lid in lamplight, no words legible beyond the marks
image.notes: Letter after: BOX 40 · NOV 2026– . The dash open.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The last register line, open after the dash.
